## About
Total Home Environmental HVAC is a family owned and operated heating and cooling company on Marcelina Ave in Torrance. We work on air conditioners and furnaces, gas and electric, for homeowners across the South Bay.
When we come out, we look over the whole system, explain what we find in plain terms and give you honest recommendations with a detailed quote. Repairs we perform are backed by a lifetime warranty.
Neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating across 443 Google reviews. If your AC is blowing warm or your furnace won't start, give us a call.

## Services
- AC repair: A full system diagnostic, a clear explanation of the problem and a detailed quote. Right now repairs are 15% off.
- AC installation and replacement: We assess your current system and home layout, then walk you through energy-efficient options that fit your budget.
- AC maintenance and tune-ups: Routine visits that include an inspection, coil cleaning, refrigerant check and thermostat calibration to catch small issues early.
- Filter replacement: Replacement of a 1 inch standard filter, plus safety and performance inspections by a factory-trained technician. ($89)
- Gas and electric furnace service: Repair and service for gas and electric furnaces, including floor and wall furnaces.
- Ductless mini split installation: Ductless mini split air conditioners for rooms or homes without ductwork.
- Air duct sealing and repair: Sealing, repair and installation of air ducts.
- Whole-house air purification: Air purification for the whole house as part of our indoor air quality work.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge a service call fee?
A: There's no service-call or trip fee when we complete the repair.

Q: Are your technicians licensed and insured?
A: Yes. Our technicians are licensed, insured and highly trained.

Q: Can I pay over time without interest?
A: Yes. You can choose a 12- or 24-month plan with no interest, as long as the full balance is paid off within that time.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're based in Torrance and work across the South Bay, including Redondo Beach, Manhattan Beach and Long Beach, as well as other parts of Southern California.
